title: Planting calendar
summary: A climate-driven calendar that tells the user what to sow or plant out, and when, for their exact location. Windows come from crop temperature rules applied to local climate history, avoid both frost and excessive heat, and adjust to the forecast.

features.title: Climate-based windows
features.story: As a beginner gardener, I want sowing, plant-out and harvest windows calculated from my location's climate so that I know when to plant each crop without guessing.
acceptance: Given a plot location, the app shows direct-sow, plant-out and harvest windows for each catalog crop
Windows come from crop temperature rules applied to 30 years of local climate history, not fixed months
Changing the plot location recalculates the windows
Calculation runs on the server with fixed rules (no AI) and results are cached per plot
Windows for Alentejo match a reference regional sowing calendar within about 2 weeks for 10 sample crops
